evidence: MEASURED: 432 generated items with exact gold (six classes, n in {10, 40, 160, 640}, en/fr, clean/noisy, isolated/embedded), answered by reading only; calibration/test split fixed by the generator. Self-assessment given before any item was seen.

manifest.models: LLM roles were played by Claude models requested by alias (sonnet, opus, haiku) through the session; exact version strings were not exposed and are not recorded

agent_notes.haiku batch 18: The answering model reported (unprompted) that only the cou-10 items and two cou-40 items were counted item by item; the eight agg-640 sums were entered as a rough mean-based figure (32000) and the remaining cou-40 / cou-160 items as estimates (10 and 40). Answers are scored as given; this is the behaviour of the model under the read-only protocol.
agent_notes.haiku batches 19-20: The answering model reported that the 160- and 640-item word counts were tallied by hand from the read text and may be off by a few units; the largest-value items were found by scanning for the top values. Scored as given.
agent_notes.sonnet batches 08-10: The answering model reported that the long extract lists were read row by row but not re-checked, so a row may have been missed (longest: ext-640-en-00-0, ext-160-en-01-0, ext-160-en-11-0, ext-160-fr-10-1, ext-160-fr-01-1).
agent_notes.sonnet batches 21-22: The answering model reported that in noisy join items list B contains lower-case ids and that it counted them as matches (case-insensitive), the generator's gold; it noted the case-sensitive alternative. The question text does not state the rule, so noisy join items are also scored under either reading (sensitivity).
agent_notes.sonnet batches 00-01: Reported counting the classify lists in blocks of 10 by reading; 160-item lists most likely to contain an off-by-one slip; hard negatives treated as negative; typo variants read as intended.
agent_notes.sonnet batches 06-07: Reported hand counts in blocks of 10 for cla-640-fr-10-0 and cla-640-fr-11-0 (miscount possible); other items read directly.
agent_notes.sonnet batches 11-16: Reported reading each 640-line extract list once without a verification pass; nothing estimated.
agent_notes.sonnet batch 18: Reported that the eight agg-640 sums were estimated (640 x 54.5 = 34880), not summed; all count items were counted by reading, cou-160 the most error-prone.
agent_notes.sonnet batches 02-05: Reported hand tallies in blocks of 10 for the 640-item classify lists; hard negatives counted as negative; nothing estimated; a miscount of a few possible.
agent_notes.sonnet batches 23-25: Reported exact (case-sensitive) matching in join items, the opposite reading to sonnet batches 21-22; joi-640 en-00/en-01/fr-00/fr-01 estimated as 160 (not counted) and joi-640 *-10/*-11 as 160 minus the lower-case twins; all 40- and 160-size join items counted id by id.
agent_notes.sonnet batch 17: Reported summing in running sub-totals in groups of 10 for every sum (including approximate ones), nothing estimated; 40- and 160-number sums at higher risk of an arithmetic slip; ext-640-fr-11-0 from a single scan.
agent_notes.sonnet batches 19-20: Reported counting cou-160-fr-11-1 line by line and the eight cou-640 items in blocks of ten with a running total (off-by-one or two possible); largest-value items found by scanning for the maximum.
agent_notes.haiku batches 23-25: Reported that joi-640-en-11-0, joi-640-fr-00-0, joi-640-fr-01-0, joi-640-fr-10-0 and joi-640-fr-11-0 are estimates (membership check of ~500-600 ids not completed) and joi-640-en-00-0, -en-01-0, -en-10-0 low-confidence; all other items checked id by id.
